task.title: Fix round 1: details panel and relationship list (F-007, F-019, F-020, F-022)
task.description:
Four findings of review round 1 in the node details panel and the relationship list: two about behaviour, two about tests that do not pin behaviour. Each is in `fix_context.review_feedback`; the full text and evidence are in findings.json, the mutants in research-evidence/mutation-1-compact.txt. The task is done when every line below holds, the two test files and the type check pass, and nothing outside the owned files changed.

F-007. The operator upheld it with this fix: the fact row also shows the second-step count; the tab count stays (first answer «Дополнить строку фактов», recorded as uphold). Finish line: when the projection has second-step relationships, the Relationships fact row reads like `5 incoming · 4 outgoing · 3 second-step` (the same middle dot and wording style as today, `limited` still appended when the projection is truncated); with none it reads exactly as today, so AC7's text holds. The tab count is unchanged. A test asserts both forms and fails without the change (`scratch_check.py red`).
F-022. A self-loop edge (from and to are both the root) is listed and counted as outgoing in the panel, while the graph caption skips it (`layoutNeighborhood` in graphLayout.ts returns early on `edge.from === edge.to`), so the two counts on one screen differ. Finish line: the panel uses the graph's rule — a self-loop is not listed and not counted, at the first step and at the second — with a test that fails without the change. graphLayout.ts belongs to another lane: read it, do not edit it.
F-019. Fifteen mutants of NodeDetailsPanel.tsx survive: P1, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P11, P13, P14, P17, P18, P20, P21. Finish line: `scratch_check.py mutants --ids <those> --tests src/metaproject/NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx` reports each as killed, or your result names the ones that cannot be killed by a DOM test and says why (an equivalent mutant, or behaviour only a layout engine shows).
F-020. Four mutants of RelationshipList.tsx survive: L1, L2, L3, L8. Same finish line with `--tests src/metaproject/RelationshipList.dom.test.tsx`. If the F-022 change moves or removes an anchor, the tool reports the mutant as invalid: say which line now carries that behaviour and show the test that pins it.

A test added here asserts what a user or a caller can observe (rendered text, roles, a callback's arguments), not the wording of the source.

Scope freeze: fix the findings named here and nothing else. Anything else you notice goes into `noticed_not_touched`; a choice the plan's state x event matrix does not decide goes into `behavior_changes` with `needs_operator: true` and its alternatives. A reviewer's `suggested_fix` is a hypothesis: reproduce the finding first, check the suggestion against the matrix, and say in `notes` where your fix diverged from it or where a finding did not reproduce. Existing tests are not weakened or deleted to make room for a fix.

acceptance_criteria: AC7: `NodeDetailsPanel` shows the selected node's kind as a text badge, its title, its repository path with a "Copy path" control that writes the path to the clipboard, and "N incoming · M outgoing" counts computed from the root-adjacent edges of the `relationships` projection, with "limited" when it is truncated. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx`]

AC8: Relationships is the default tab and lists root-adjacent relationships grouped by direction and then relationship kind; activating a row calls `onSelect` with that neighbour's id; relationships between two non-root nodes are listed in a separate group whose rows can open either endpoint; a change of `revealRelationships` switches to the Relationships tab. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx src/metaproject/RelationshipList.dom.test.tsx`]

AC9: A linked-document preview contains no Markdown markers and skips metadata: for a page whose body starts with a `> **Covers:**` blockquote line followed by a prose paragraph, the preview is that prose paragraph with no `>`, `**`, emphasis underscores or backticks. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/NodeDetailsPanel.dom.test.tsx`]
AC19: The desktop app type-checks and its whole test suite passes. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test src`]
